name: fmp_equity_offering
description:
Latest exempt equity offering filings (Form D / Reg A) from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/equity-offering-rss as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
For crowdfunding use fmp_crowdfunding_rss; for IPOs fmp_ipo_calendar.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {}
